facts.material: ovalbumin protein (egg-white protein), produced by microbial fermentation

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 3502 covers albumins, including egg albumin; chapter 35 note 1 exclusions (yeasts, blood fractions, hardened proteins) do not apply

rejected_alternatives.reason: egg albumin other than dried; product is a powder
other albumins; arguable since not from eggs, but ovalbumin is egg albumin by name
birds' eggs, not produced by an egg
food preparation; product is a single albumin protein

missing_facts: Whether not derived from egg affects the egg albumin line
classification.rationale: Powdered ovalbumin is an albumin of heading 3502; ovalbumin is egg albumin and it is dried, so 3502.11. Fermentation origin makes 3502.90 arguable. No relevant ruling was found.
